description: Use first for a plain question such as "does CBD help epilepsy", "where does THC act" or "what binds TRPV1": finds the compounds, conditions and receptors the question names in the atlas and answers only from those records: the evidence grade, the key findings with PubMed identifiers, the atlas pages, a not medical advice line and cite_as (title, url, licence, accessed date). When the question names nothing the atlas holds, it says so and suggests the closest names and tools. Educational reference, not medical advice. No doses.

question.description: A plain question that names a compound, a condition or a receptor, for example "does CBD help epilepsy".

name: ask_atlas
title: Ask the atlas a question
